act-decommission-inactivity-field.answer: No. SaniTap will not decommission or retire water points for inactivity. A pump with no recent activity is a maintenance question, not a register question.

act-run-sdws-26-premises.answer: Superseded, not abandoned. The premise was that SDWS 26 had no field instrument and no data until a new round ran. Both were false: the annual monitoring survey (form 2eeb8682) already carried the usage question in both seasons and had been run 11-21 November 2025, giving 410 responses that answered both seasons. The parameter is measured for the 2025 monitoring period. Replaced by act-sdws26-annual-round, which makes it a recurring annual obligation rather than a one-off, and by act-sdws26-approve-2025 for the approval state.

act-sdws26-instrument-review.answer: Superseded. The review was scoped to sign an instrument off BEFORE round one, and round one had already run - on the annual monitoring survey, not on the point-of-use form the review was written against. The substance is not lost: which form is the standing SDWS 26 instrument, and whether it must also carry SDWS 22 boiling, the JMP core questions, the enumerator's identity and the household-versus-institution split, is carried into act-sdws26-annual-round as the question to settle before the 2026 round.

act-standardised-stroke-test-basis.answer: Yes. The standardised stroke test is SDWS 28 of ERSDWS V2, and the five-minute test is the accepted method pending the StrokeMeter.
act-standardised-stroke-test-basis.source: email “Re: Water program dashboard & actions”, 18 September 2026

act-confirm-maroantsetra-fnrb-value.answer: Maroantsetra fNRB is 36%, not 34%, in line with the sub-national value applied for Fort-Dauphin; James corrects it at verification.
act-confirm-maroantsetra-fnrb-value.source: email “Re: Water program dashboard & actions” from James Walker, 2026-09-21

act-confirm-whether-ersdws-v2.answer: v2.0 applies from 1 January 2026 with some grandfathering; alignment at the verification submission (Q1 2027), full alignment at the crediting-period renewal; v2.0 to be tried for 2025 through the design-change pathway.
act-confirm-whether-ersdws-v2.source: email “Re: Water program dashboard & actions” from James Walker, 2026-09-21

act-v2-sample-size.answer: 50 per stratum for sampling, to be safe.
act-v2-sample-size.source: email “Re: Water program dashboard & actions” from James Walker, 2026-09-21

act-v2-nonclaiming.source: email “Re: Water program dashboard & actions” from James Walker, 2026-09-21

act-sdws27-basis.answer: Capped at 347 days without a sensor; actual days claimable only for sensor-fitted pumps, sampled 50 per stratum, with the cap on the rest; a lost or damaged calendar is acceptable given the SOP, visits and call log. James Walker's ruling, not Gold Standard's.
act-sdws27-basis.source: email “Re: Water program dashboard & actions” from James Walker, 2026-09-21

act-settle-baseline-boiling-device.answer: The ex post figures are adjusted by the share of end users reporting an improved cookstove in the annual monitoring; Fort-Dauphin 2025: 81%.
act-settle-baseline-boiling-device.source: email “Re: Water program dashboard & actions” from James Walker, 2026-09-18

act-reconcile-cookstove-water-programmes.answer: The methodology provides for cookstove and safe-water cross-effects; the stacking prohibition applies to Impact Statements only, not to credits.
act-reconcile-cookstove-water-programmes.source: email “Re: Water program dashboard & actions” from James Walker, 2026-09-18
